question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Few people turned up to attend the __tawdry__ promo of the new movie.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tawdry"** means something that is showy but cheap and of poor quality. (सस्ता और भड़कीला)

 
 
• **Example: **She wore a tawdry dress that looked flashy but was made of inferior fabric.
 
 
 
• **"Elegant"** refers to something that is pleasingly graceful and stylish in appearance or manner. (शालीन)
 
 
• **Example: **She chose an elegant gown for the evening gala, which was both stylish and sophisticated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'tawdry'** is **'elegant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gaudy **(भड़कीला): Extravagantly bright or showy, typically to be tasteless.

 
 
• **Example:** The decorations were so gawdy that they overwhelmed the small room.
 
 
 
• **Inferior** (निम्न): Lower in rank, status, or quality.
 
 
• **Example: **The inferior quality of the product led to many customer complaints.
 
 
 
• **Showy** (दिखावटी): Having a striking appearance or style, typically by being excessively bright, colourful, or ostentatious.
 
 
• **Example:** The showy outfit attracted a lot of attention at the party.
